questionText:
Match the pictorial element in List I with its description in List II:

List I:
(A) Prince Dara Shikoh
(B) Emperor Shah Jahan
(C) Royal Procession Crowd
(D) Night Sky Illuminations

List II:
(I) Riding a white horse alongside his son, distinguished by a radiant golden halo
(II) Mounted on an energetic brown horse, wearing a magnificent pearl-tasseled sehra
(III) Dazzling fireworks (aatishbazi), sparklers, and torches lighting up the dark nocturnal sky
(IV) Nobles on caparisoned elephants, cavalrymen, dancing girls, drummers, and excited onlookers

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Dara Shikoh wears the pearl sehra on a brown horse; Shah Jahan rides beside him with a halo; fireworks light the night sky; elephants, musicians, and crowds follow.
Hence, Option C is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
